facts.en: Completed a bicycle repair certificate at Fictional Spokefield Training Centre in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构辐田培训中心完成自行车维修证书课程。

facts.en: Paid trainee technician at Fictional Cloverhub Cycles from 2023-07 to 2024-06.
facts.zh: 2023-07 至 2024-06 在虚构三叶轮毂自行车店任有薪见习技术员。

facts.en: Paid workshop technician at the same shop from 2024-07 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2026-08 在同一店铺任有薪工坊技术员。

facts.en: Replaces inner tubes, chains and brake cables on conventional pedal bicycles using the shop’s work instructions.
facts.zh: 依据店铺作业说明，为普通脚踏自行车更换内胎、链条及刹车线。

facts.en: Checks wheel seating, brake operation and gear changes against the post-repair checklist.
facts.zh: 依据维修后核对表检查车轮是否安装到位、刹车功能及变速情况。

facts.en: Writes the replaced parts and observed issues on each work card before supervisor review.
facts.zh: 在主管审核前，将已更换零件及观察到的问题写入各工单。

facts.en: The senior mechanic signs the release check; the candidate does not authorize release of repaired bicycles.
facts.zh: 高级技师签署交车检查；候选人不授权维修后自行车交付。

facts.en: Helped reorganize the common-cable storage rack in 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-03 协助重整常用线缆存放架。

facts.en: Personally measured and labelled 14 storage compartments; the senior mechanic approved the part categories.
facts.zh: 个人测量并标注 14 个存放格；零件分类由高级技师批准。

facts.en: A one-day 2025-10 work-card sample lists 9 bicycles handled by the candidate, including 2 awaiting supervisor release at closing.
facts.zh: 一份 2025-10 单日工单抽样列出候选人处理的 9 辆自行车，其中 2 辆在关店时仍待主管批准交付。

facts.en: The sample does not establish that the 2 pending bicycles were delivered that day.
facts.zh: 该抽样未证明 2 辆待批准自行车在当天交付。

facts.en: Uses hand tools, work-card records and a parts catalogue for assigned mechanical repairs.
facts.zh: 使用手工具、工单记录及零件目录完成分配的机械维修。

facts.en: Completed the shop’s internal workbench and tool induction in 2023-07.
facts.zh: 2023-07 完成店铺内部工作台及工具入职培训。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Fernwheel Leisure Rides in 2022, preparing route handouts and a sign-in table.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构蕨轮休闲骑行团做志愿者，准备路线说明及签到台。

facts.en: Built a personal wooden bicycle display stand in 2024 from a supplied craft plan.
facts.zh: 2024 年依据提供的手工方案制作个人木制自行车展示架。

facts.en: Enjoys recreational cycling and sketching imagined frame colour schemes.
facts.zh: 爱好休闲骑行及绘制想象中的车架配色。

facts.en: Explains supervisor-approved repair notes to customers and refers additional work requests for a new estimate.
facts.zh: 向客户说明主管批准的维修记录，并将新增维修请求转交以重新报价。

facts.en: Keeps bicycles with unresolved faults labelled and separate from the collection area.
facts.zh: 为存在未解决故障的自行车贴标，并与取车区分开存放。

facts.en: No electrical diagnosis, battery servicing or powered-drive repair work is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录电气诊断、电池维护或动力驱动系统维修工作。
